title: Adjusted EBITDA and non-GAAP reconciliation
prompt:
Prepare the LTM June 30 adjusted EBITDA reconciliation for the controller's close review.

Use the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition correspondence, the v4 controller-review workpapers, the current jurisdiction and book-detail export, the tax review notes, and the signed non-GAAP reporting policy. Treat the v2 pre-close workbook as change history only. Use the contractor-accounting MCP for posted LTM revenue and EBITDA.

Reconcile GAAP net income to posted EBITDA using depreciation and amortization, interest expense, and income tax expense. Assess every proposed adjustment under the signed policy. Exclude normal recurring operating costs and uncommitted savings, include only qualifying acquisition, restructuring, or unusual items net of related recoveries, and do not double count amounts already excluded from GAAP EBITDA.

Show the accepted and rejected adjustments, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA margin on posted LTM revenue, and the largest rejected item by proposed dollar amount.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `gaap_net_income`, `ebitda`, `accepted_adjustments`, `rejected_adjustments`, `adjusted_ebitda`, `adjusted_ebitda_margin`, `largest_rejected_item`. Use dollar amounts to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
